title: 送綦毋潜落第还乡
title_en: Seeing Off Qiwu Qian as He Goes Home after Failing the Exam
author: 王维

text_note.zh: 语料库第十一句作“櫂”，是“棹”的异体字；第十四句语料库作“孤村当落晖”，通行本多作“孤城”。另外“置酒临长道”有的本子作“置酒长安道”。
text_note.en: In line eleven the corpus uses an old variant form of the character for oar. In line fourteen the corpus has "lonely village", while most common editions have "lonely city". Some editions also have "the Chang'an road" instead of "the long road" in line nine.

readings.zh: “缝”作动词，是用针线缝，读 féng。
readings.en: As a verb, to sew, this character is read féng.

readings.zh: “长道”是长长的大路，“长”读 cháng。
readings.en: Cháng dào means a long road, so this character is read cháng.

readings.zh: “行当”是将要的意思，“行”读 xíng。
readings.en: Xíng dāng means soon, about to, so this character is read xíng.
Wèi jǐ means before long; this character is read jǐ.

glosses.zh: 圣代：圣明的时代，是对当时朝代的称赞。
glosses.en: shèng dài: a wise and good age, words of praise for the times.

glosses.zh: 隐者：不肯做官、住在山林里的人。
glosses.en: yǐn zhě: a hermit, someone who refuses to be an official and lives in the hills.

glosses.zh: 东山客：东晋的谢安曾经在东山隐居，后来出山做了大官。这里用来比喻綦毋潜。
glosses.en: dōng shān kè: the guest of the Eastern Hills. Xie An of the Jin dynasty lived as a hermit in the Eastern Hills before becoming a great minister. Here it stands for Qiwu Qian.

glosses.zh: 采薇：采野菜吃。商朝灭亡后，伯夷、叔齐不肯吃周朝的粮食，躲到山里采薇菜吃。这里代指隐居。
glosses.en: cǎi wēi: gathering wild ferns to eat. When the Shang dynasty fell, Boyi and Shuqi refused to eat Zhou grain and hid in the hills eating ferns. Here it means living as a hermit.

glosses.zh: 君门远：皇宫的大门太远，进不去，指没有考中。
glosses.en: jūn mén yuǎn: the palace gate is too far away to reach, meaning he failed the exam.

glosses.zh: 孰云吾道非：谁说我们走的路不对呢？孔子曾经问学生“吾道非邪”，意思是“难道我的主张错了吗”。
glosses.en: shú yún wú dào fēi: who says our way is wrong? Confucius once asked his students whether his way could be wrong.

glosses.zh: 江淮：长江和淮河一带，是綦毋潜回家要经过的地方。
glosses.en: jiāng huái: the land around the Yangtze and Huai rivers, on Qiwu Qian's way home.

glosses.zh: 寒食：寒食节，在清明节前一两天，这天不生火做饭，只吃冷食。
glosses.en: hán shí: the Cold Food Festival, a day or two before Qingming, when people lit no fires and ate only cold food.

glosses.zh: 京洛：本指洛阳，这里泛指京城。
glosses.en: jīng luò: Luoyang, used here for the capital in general.
zhì jiǔ: setting out wine for a farewell meal.
tóng xīn: a close friend who shares your heart.
wéi: to leave, to part from.

glosses.zh: 桂棹：桂木做的船桨，代指船。
glosses.en: guì zhào: an oar of cassia wood, standing for the boat.

glosses.zh: 拂荆扉：推开自家的柴门，就是到家了。荆扉，用荆条编的门。
glosses.en: fú jīng fēi: brushing open his own rough door, that is, getting home. Jīng fēi is a door woven from thorny branches.
dài: to surround, to wrap around.
luò huī: the last light of the setting sun.

glosses.zh: 吾谋适不用：你的主张恰好没被采用。适，恰好、偶然。
glosses.en: wú móu shì bù yòng: your plan just happened not to be used. Shì means by chance.
zhī yīn: a friend who truly understands you.

translation.zh: 在这圣明的时代，没有人去隐居，
translation.en: In this wise age, no one hides away as a hermit;

translation.zh: 有才能的人都来到朝廷做事。
translation.en: all the gifted people come to serve the court.
So even a hermit like you

translation.zh: 也不再去山中采薇隐居。
translation.en: no longer stays in the hills gathering ferns.

translation.zh: 你来到京城，却没能走进皇宫的大门，
translation.en: You came to the capital, but could not reach the palace gate.

translation.zh: 可谁说我们的道路错了呢？
translation.en: Yet who can say our way is wrong?

translation.zh: 你将在江淮一带过寒食节，
translation.en: You will spend the Cold Food Festival out by the Yangtze and Huai.

translation.zh: 在京城时，你曾缝好了春天的衣服。
translation.en: Here in the capital you had your spring clothes sewn.

translation.zh: 我在长长的大道边摆酒为你送行，
translation.en: I set out wine for you beside the long road;

translation.zh: 知心的朋友就要和我分别了。
translation.en: my close friend is leaving me.

translation.zh: 你很快就会乘着桂木桨的小船，
translation.en: Soon you will float off in a boat with a cassia oar,

translation.zh: 不久就能推开家里的柴门。
translation.en: and before long you will push open your own rough door.

translation.zh: 远处的树林环绕着远行的你，
translation.en: The far-off trees wrap around you as you travel,

translation.zh: 孤零零的城池正对着落日的余晖。
translation.en: and a lonely city faces the setting sun.

translation.zh: 你的主张只是恰好没被采用，
translation.en: Your ideas just happened not to be taken up this time.

translation.zh: 千万不要说世上懂你的人太少。
translation.en: Do not say there are few who understand you.

background.zh: 綦毋潜（綦毋是复姓）是王维的朋友，江南一带的人。他到京城参加进士考试，没有考中，要回家乡去。王维摆酒为他送行，写了这首诗安慰和鼓励他。綦毋潜后来在开元十四年（726年）考中了进士。这首诗写在他考中之前，具体是哪一年，说法不一。
background.en: Qiwu Qian (Qiwu is a two-character family name) was Wang Wei's friend, from the south of the Yangtze. He came to the capital to take the top exam, failed, and was going home. Wang Wei held a farewell meal for him and wrote this poem to comfort and cheer him up. Qiwu Qian later passed the exam in 726. This poem was written before that, but people disagree about the exact year.

author_note.zh: 王维（701？—761），字摩诘，唐代大诗人、画家，人称“诗佛”。他二十出头就考中了进士，很早就有名气。他的诗清新自然，苏轼说他“诗中有画”。他待朋友很真诚，写过不少送别诗，这首诗就像一位老朋友在耐心地劝慰落榜的伙伴。
author_note.en: Wang Wei (701?–761), also called Mojie, was a great Tang poet and painter, known as the Buddha of Poetry. He passed the top exam in his early twenties and became famous young. His poems are fresh and natural; Su Shi said there were paintings in his poems. He was sincere with friends and wrote many farewell poems. In this one he sounds like an old friend patiently comforting a pal who failed the exam.

appreciation.zh: 考试落榜，心情一定很难过。王维怎么安慰朋友呢？开头先说：现在是好时代，有才的人都来做事，你也是其中一个。然后说：这次没考上，只是皇宫的门太远，不是你的路走错了。中间写送别：你回家会路过江淮，在那里过寒食节；我在大路边摆酒送你，你坐船走了，很快就能到家。“远树带行客，孤城当落晖”是一幅画：远处的树林环绕着远去的小船，孤城对着夕阳，有点寂寞，也很美。最后两句最温暖：这次只是碰巧没被选上，别说没人懂你，我就懂你。
appreciation.en: Failing an exam must feel terrible. How does Wang Wei comfort his friend? First he says these are good times, and gifted people all come to serve, and you are one of them. Then he says this failure only means the palace gate was too far this time; it does not mean your way is wrong. The middle is the farewell. You will pass the Yangtze and Huai and spend the Cold Food Festival there. I set out wine by the road, you leave by boat, and soon you will be home. The lines about the far trees and the lonely city are a painting. The trees wrap around the boat as it goes, and a lonely city faces the sunset, a little lonely and very beautiful. The last two lines are the warmest. This time you just happened not to be chosen. Do not say no one understands you. I do.
